title: TopologyOverlaySignalThreshold
description: One threshold band or comparison requested for a topology overlay signal. topology-service validates the field, value type, and tone against catalog metadata and supported effects.

field.description: Catalog-backed field or derived signal field to compare, for example traffic.util_pct.

tone.description: Bounded presentation tone emitted after backend threshold evaluation.

label.description: Optional display label for this threshold band.
